title: MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.01641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. translated_title: MCIR：一种具有可靠性保证的特征依赖感知可解释性方法
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习模型通常包含强依赖或冗余的特征，这使得特征归因变得困难，因为共享的预测信息可能分散在相关的预测变量之间。因此，现有方法（如SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI和SAGE）在多重共线性或近似重复预测变量的情况下可能产生不稳定的特征排序。我们提出了互相关影响比率方法（MCIR-M），这是一种依赖感知的全局特征重要性方法，用于量化每个特征在选定依赖邻域之外所贡献的独特预测信息。MCIR-M引入了互相关影响比率（MCIR），该方法将每个特征以强依赖的邻居特征为条件进行条件化，并计算条件信息与块级信息之间的归一化比率。总体得分位于[0,1]区间内，且在精确条件冗余的情况下等于零。我们还引入了一种轻量级的估计程序……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了MCIR-M方法，通过将特征条件化于强依赖邻居并计算归一化的信息比率，在特征强相关或冗余的场景下仍能提供稳定且具有可靠性保证的全局特征重要性度量。
en_tdlr: Proposes MCIR-M, a dependence-aware global feature-importance method that conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbors and computes a normalized conditional-to-block information ratio, yielding stable feature rankings with reliability guarantees even under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors.
